title: Enhancements
subtitle: Optional quality-of-life tweaks for your VRChat experience.

linux-screenshot-symlink.title: Screenshots to ~/Pictures/VRChat
linux-screenshot-symlink.blurb: Links the Proton screenshot folder to ~/Pictures/VRChat. Existing photos are moved over.

vrchat-protocol-handler.title: Handle vrchat:// links
vrchat-protocol-handler.blurb: Opens vrchat:// invite links through VRC Circle and takes you into the instance, whether VRChat is already running or needs to launch. On Linux it also bridges the link across Proton, which the desktop can't do on its own.

detail.registered: VRC Circle is the vrchat:// handler.
